en: The postcard has two sides: One displays a monochrome rural landscape with fields, wooden fences, several farm buildings, and a large country house or manor at the center, with forest and hills in the background. The other side is handwritten in Swedish, with a green Swedish stamp (5 öre) featuring a profile portrait and postmark, and is addressed to Fröken Jenny Bergström in Ängom, Hjärnunda.
